track: Use case: precise-object-edit. Create an original game pickup sprite replacing the lifebuoy and anchor entirely with ONE heavy forged steel open-ended wrench. Input image 1 is the rescue pickup to replace; input image 2 is the shield pickup as material/style reference. Transparent background, isolated object only, no backdrop or shadow plane. Wrench handle points bottom left, open jaw points top right: exactly 45 degrees diagonal. A broad unmistakable open U-shaped angular jaw with TWO equally substantial jaws and a wide deep transparent opening, long thick straight handle with rounded solid closed butt; no ring at the butt. Steel silver front face, dark iron beveled thickness, restrained warm brass inset on handle and warm edge highlights. Match chunky volumetric painted game-icon rendering, high contrast heavy silhouette, slightly worn metal, full color and softly antialiased edge like the original pickup. Object is nearly frontal with visible bevel depth; no foreshortening. No lifebuoy, no anchor, no hook, no chain, no ropes, no extra objects, no text, no logo, no watermark, no glow. Compose centered in a square transparent canvas with small margins; readable at 58 pixels wide.
ui: Use case: precise-object-edit. Replace the hook symbol in input image 1 with an original pixel art heavy steel OPEN-END WRENCH icon. Input image 2 (shield) is the exact low resolution chunky pixel art style and palette reference. One wrench only, centered, no frame. True transparent background. Design as an EXACT 24 by 24 pixel icon, enlarged using nearest neighbor only if needed: each pixel block identical size on a 24x24 grid, no antialiasing, no gradients, no noise or tiny details. The wrench extends diagonally from bottom-left solid rounded handle butt to top-right open jaw at exactly 45 degrees. Occupy about 18x18 pixels within the 24x24 canvas, keep blank margins. The wide angular U-shaped wrench head has TWO sturdy equal jaws with a broad 3-pixel-wide deep open notch toward top right. Long straight thick handle. Outer contour near black #0b0a10, dark steel #2a3038, medium steel #465058 and #6c7880, light steel #9aa8ac and #d0d8d4, a restrained warm highlight #e8d0a8 on the handle. Hard flat shading, dark outline, minimal interior details. No hole or ring at handle butt. No hook, no anchor, no rope, no lifebuoy, no text, no logo, no border, no glow. Silhouette immediately readable at 24 pixels beside the shield.
